name: Haunted One
clause: Commander creatures you own have "Whenever ~ becomes tapped, it and other creatures you control that share a creature type with it each get +2/+0 and gain undying until end of turn."

needs.proposedSignature: Filter gains `sharesCreatureTypeWith?: Ref | 'commander'`, `commander?: boolean` and `owned?: boolean` (owner rather than controller)
needs.semantics: Two filter predicates a large tribal/commander slice of the pool needs: 'creatures you control that share a creature type with it' and 'commander creatures you own'. Pure matchesFilter work, no new op.
needs.clause: Commander creatures you own have "... it and other creatures you control that share a creature type with it each get +2/+0 ..."

needs.proposedSignature: add 'undying' (and 'persist') to CoreKeyword so anthem.keywords / grant-keyword / self-keywords can carry it; the body already exists as { op: 'return-self-to-battlefield', counters: { counter: '+1/+1', amount: 1 } } gated on { kind: 'self-no-counters', counter: '+1/+1' }
needs.semantics: Undying as a GRANTABLE keyword. The behaviour exists for a card that prints it; what is missing is a keyword token an anthem or pump can hand to OTHER creatures ('Other non-Human creatures you control get +1/+1 and have undying'). Adding it to the Keyword union also gives the round-trip scorer its vocabulary entry, since KEYWORD_EXPANSIONS already carries the undying rules text.
needs.clause: Other non-Human creatures you control get +1/+1 and have undying.
